name: GitHub Push
description: Pushing to GitHub repository local changes

github_url.description: GitHub url or GitHub Enterprise url

ssh.description: Specify if ssh should be used

repository.description: Repository name to push. Default or empty value represents current github repository (${GITHUB_REPOSITORY})

force.description: Determines if force push is used

force_with_lease.description: Determines if force-with-lease push is used

atomic.description: Determines if atomic push is used, default true

directory.description: Directory to change to before pushing.
